summary: Willamette NF summit near McKenzie Bridge, OR: L-6 cab from 1934, Aircraft Warning Service post 1942-43, cab removed 1958 (one source says 1976); no source describes remains.

facts.status_note: Cab removed 1958 per two sources (1976 per firelookout.com); no source describes what remains

events.note: Register says the site started in 1934 with an L-6 cab; Rex's page shows a lookout house under way in 1933 and CCC work still going in October 1935
Aircraft Warning Service station activated August 11, 1942
AWS cabin built a quarter mile west of the old cab
AWS station deactivated September 22, 1943; observer Wanda Drury recorded in 1943
firelookout.com says the cab was gone by 1976; conflicts with the 1958 removal date
Registered with the Former Fire Lookout Sites register on May 7, 2011

evidence.supports: site lies about ten miles northeast of McKenzie Bridge
Willamette National Forest, Lane County, Oregon
started in 1934 with an L-6 cab; AWS cabin built a quarter mile west in 1942; cab removed in 1958
evidence.quote: Started in 1934 with this L-6 cab, an Aircraft Warning Service cabin was built 1/4 mile to the west in 1942. Used until 1956, the cab was removed in 1958.

evidence.supports: crews were working on a lookout house on Gold Hill in September 1933
evidence.quote: They are working on a lookout house on Gold Hill.

evidence.supports: CCC workers still building the lookout post in late October 1935 (Register-Guard, October 30, 1935), slowed by snow
evidence.quote: CCC workmen constructing the lookout post on Gold Hill are handicapped by eight inches of snow.

evidence.supports: Aircraft Warning Service station activated August 11, 1942 and deactivated September 22, 1943; Eugene Filter Center listed
evidence.quote: Activated: August 11, 1942; Deactivated: September 22, 1943. Eugene Filter Center.
1943: Wanda Drury was the AWS observer.

evidence.supports: cab in use until 1956; firelookout.com says it was gone by 1976
evidence.quote: Used until 1956, the cab was gone by 1976.

evidence.supports: register date: Former Fire Lookout Sites registration, May 7, 2011

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says the site started in 1934 with an L-6 cab. Rex's page shows crews working on a lookout house in September 1933 and CCC workers still building the post in October 1935. These sources do not settle the first build date.
Two sources give 1958 for removal of the cab. firelookout.com says the cab was gone by 1976 and its heading reads 1934-1976. The story uses 1958 and reports the 1976 date as a conflict.

notes_for_editor: Access left unset: no source gives an access level, and the brief's 'unknown' is not a valid enum value. A Forest Service Gold Hill trailhead listing turned up in search, but the cached page is a generic recreation index and a WebFetch redirect went to the same index, so no current access or site condition was found. The register page (firetower.org, source 2) does list 'Date Registered May 7, 2011', so the fflos_registered event is included (an earlier note said the date was not found). The summit's current condition is undescribed in every source read.
